description.en:
Sets a character name placeholder for the next messages. Placeholders are filled in the text of the next messages: the value is stored under a key made from the kind and the index, which the message parser reads when it meets the matching tag in the text.
The key is REP_CHR_F<index> (full name) or, with fullName false, REP_CHR_P<index>. With isParamId true, the value is taken as a parameter ID hash and turned into the character's base ID first; the function returns null if that fails.
Placeholder number used in the message text (0, 1, 2...).
Character: a base ID, or a parameter ID hash (CMND_GET_HASH("para_cp0010")) with isParamId true.
true when chara is a parameter ID hash.
true for the REP_CHR_F key, false for REP_CHR_P.

Always null; also null when a parameter ID cannot be converted.
null if the script system is not ready or too few arguments are given.
